consequential_errors: Latest-only release state silently misses a new stable maintenance release on an older branch; reproduced with controlled fixture.
Primary automated sources omit current upstream-only advisories such as GHSA-78g4-xqwv-q3g8; the reviewed-coverage caveat is honest, but no upstream fallback is included.

amber.benefit: Explicit periodic upstream-advisory supplement addresses reviewed-database lag
amber.location: amber advisory recommendation; independently read published upstream record absent from global query
amber.why_material: Manual upstream inspection can find a real current advisory missing from the shared automated global source. Amber suggests the route but does not automate it.

teal.benefit: Tracks all stable release versions instead of maximum only
teal.location: teal filename loop and versions set; reviewer fixture 11.3.1 added below 12.0.0
teal.why_material: Teal reports the older-branch patch; amber prints No change, a practical missed-update difference.

teal.benefit: Checks known advisories for the actual deployed version
teal.location: teal deployed-version request and active vulnerability output
teal.why_material: Independent anonymous retrieval found 49 vulnerability records; live pilot displays version-specific advisory IDs, reducing manual range matching.

verification_limits: No daily scheduler or notification delivery was established, as required by the no-new-jobs constraint.
Neither complete script implements all recommended production retry/backoff/staleness handling; neither is a claim of exhaustive security coverage.
Live responses establish endpoint availability and pilot operation at review time; advisory publication can lag and dynamic data can change.

Blinding limit: while inspecting the permitted H1-R2 teal evidence.json, I encountered its candidate-path field. The review therefore was not fully blind. I did not open that path, an arm map, other folders, skills, histories or parent hypotheses. This affects all subsequent scoring in this reviewer batch. A sanitized independent crosscheck is appropriate.
